questions.question: Zašto je Intel u FY2024 imao veliki gubitak, prema njegovom 10-K izveštaju?
questions.question_en: Why did Intel report a large loss in FY2024, according to its 10-K?

key_points: $9.9B non-cash tax charge, substantially related to valuation allowances on US net deferred tax assets
$2.8B restructuring charges from the 2024 Restructuring Plan (~15% core workforce reduction)
$3.3B non-cash impairments and accelerated depreciation of manufacturing assets (mostly Intel 7 node)
$3.1B non-cash impairment of goodwill and certain acquired intangible assets
expected_explanation.must_include: valuation allowance on deferred tax assets (najveća pojedinačna stavka)

expected_citation.filing: Intel 10-K za period koji se završava 2024-12-28, podnet 2025-01-31 (accn 0000050863-25-000009)
expected_citation.section: Item 7 MD&A -> Overview -> 'A Year in Review' i 'Restructuring'; detalji u Note 7 (Restructuring and Other Charges) i Note 8 (Income Taxes)

questions.question: Šta je, prema 10-K izveštaju, pokretalo rast prihoda NVIDIA-e u FY2024?
questions.question_en: According to its 10-K, what drove NVIDIA's revenue growth in FY2024?

key_points: Data Center revenue $47.5B, up 217% (Data Center compute up 244%, Networking up 133%)
Strong demand from enterprise software and consumer internet applications and multiple industry verticals (automotive, financial services, healthcare)
AI platforms built on Hopper / Grace Hopper / Ada for generative AI and LLM workloads; ~40% of Data Center revenue estimated to be AI inference
Large cloud providers were more than half of Data Center revenue in Q4 FY2024
Gaming up 15% (channel inventory normalization) - minor contributor
expected_explanation.must_include: Data Center segment as the main driver

expected_citation.filing: NVIDIA 10-K za period koji se završava 2024-01-28, podnet 2024-02-21 (accn 0001045810-24-000029)
expected_citation.section: Item 7 MD&A -> 'Fiscal Year 2024 Summary' i opis Data Center segmenta

questions.question: Zašto je Micron u FY2023 imao gubitak, prema njegovom 10-K izveštaju?
questions.question_en: Why did Micron report a loss in FY2023, according to its 10-K?

key_points: Memory and storage industry deteriorated sharply: weak end-market demand, macroeconomic challenges, customers reducing inventory levels
Significant declines in average selling prices: DRAM high-40s %, NAND low-50s %; total revenue down 49%
$1.83B inventory write-downs to net realizable value
$382M facility underutilization costs from reduced wafer starts
Gross margin fell from 45% to -9%
expected_explanation.must_include: ASP (price) declines for DRAM/NAND driven by weak demand / customer inventory reduction

expected_citation.filing: Micron 10-K za period koji se završava 2023-08-31, podnet 2023-10-06 (accn 0000723125-23-000054)
expected_citation.section: Item 7 MD&A -> Overview -> 'Industry Conditions'; Results of Operations -> 'Total Revenue' i 'Consolidated Gross Margin'

questions.question: Za NVIDIA-u, AMD i Intel: koliki je bio rast prihoda u FY2024 i koji je glavni razlog promene prema 10-K izveštaju svake kompanije?
questions.question_en: For NVIDIA, AMD and Intel: what was the revenue growth in fiscal year 2024, and what was the main reason for the change according to each company's 10-K?

NVDA.must_include: Data Center as the main driver (up 217%)
key_points: Data Center revenue up 217% (compute up 244%, networking up 133%)
Demand from enterprise software, consumer internet and industry verticals (AI infrastructure)

AMD.must_include: Data Center segment growth (Instinct GPUs / EPYC CPUs)
key_points: Data Center net revenue $12.6B, up 94%, from AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs
Client segment up 52% (Ryzen processors)
Partially offset by Gaming down 58% (semi-custom) and Embedded down 33% (customer inventory normalization)

INTC.must_include: decline from lower 'all other' revenue (Altera, Mobileye) and/or lower Intel Foundry external revenue, partially offset by Intel Products
key_points: Revenue $53.1B, down $1.1B or 2%
All other revenue down 32%: Altera and Mobileye customers reducing inventories
Intel Foundry external revenue down 60% (packaging services, equipment sales)
Partially offset by Intel Products up 3% (CCG up 4% on notebook volume, DCAI up 1%)

expected_explanation.min_points_for_full_credit: tačan rast i must_include za sve tri kompanije

questions.tests: brojevi + objašnjenja za više kompanija; jedan agent skuplja tekst svih u jednom dugom kontekstu

questions.question: Koja softverska kompanija je imala najnižu operativnu maržu u FY2024 i šta njen 10-K izveštaj navodi kao glavne razloge rasta operativnih troškova?
questions.question_en: Which software company had the lowest operating margin in fiscal year 2024, and what does its 10-K say were the main drivers of the increase in its operating expenses?

key_points: Increased headcount and personnel-related costs (incl. stock-based compensation) - the main driver in sales and marketing (+$330M) and R&D (+$350M)
Sales and marketing up $553M; also deferred commission amortization +$90M and marketing programs +$95M
R&D up $419M; also outside services +$48M and data center capacity costs +$27M
G&A up $73M
expected_explanation.must_include: headcount / personnel-related costs as the main driver

expected_citation.filing: ServiceNow 10-K za period koji se završava 2024-12-31, podnet 2025-01-30 (accn 0001373715-25-000010)

questions.tests: više koraka: tek posle brojeva se zna koju kompaniju treba pretražiti; planer pravi plan unapred, pa ovde multi-agent verovatno gubi

questions.question: Kako su se promenile uporedive prodaje (comparable sales) kod Lowe's-a i Best Buy-a u fiskalnoj godini koja se završila početkom 2025, i kako se to odnosi na promenu ukupnog prihoda?
questions.question_en: How did comparable sales change at Lowe's and Best Buy in the fiscal year that ended in early 2025, and how does that compare with the change in total revenue?

key_points: Lowe's: comparable sales -2.7% (transactions -3.0%, average ticket +0.3%); net sales -3.1%, decline primarily driven by comparable sales; both years had 52 weeks
Best Buy: comparable sales -2.3%, softer consumer demand; revenue -4.4% ($41.5B vs $43.5B)
Best Buy revenue fell more than comparable sales mainly because the prior year had a 53rd week (~$735M revenue); comparable sales exclude the 53rd week
expected_explanation.must_include: correct comparable sales for both (-2.7% LOW, -2.3% BBY) and that Best Buy's revenue decline is larger partly due to the 53rd week in the prior year

questions.trap: Lowe's tu godinu zove 'fiscal 2024', Best Buy 'fiscal 2025'. Agent koji uzme godinu ranije dobija LOW comparable sales -4.7% i BBY -6.8% (FY2024); postoje i 10-K za godinu koja se završila početkom 2026 (FY2026), pa greška moguća u oba smera
questions.tests: zamka sa nazivom fiskalne godine u tekstu + objašnjenje razlike (53. nedelja)
